tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Aggressive biology with enriched high-risk cytogenetic features including del(17p), t(11;14), gain/amplification(1q), del(13q), complex karyotype, and in some cases t(4;14); same broad therapeutic targets as MM but often more treatment-resistant
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Diffuse marrow effacement; circulating plasma cells; extramedullary disease common (liver, spleen, lymph nodes; also pleural effusions, soft tissue, skin, and CNS in some cases)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Plasma cells with distinct aggressive biology enabling circulation in peripheral blood (rather than confinement to marrow niche)

cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Escape from marrow niche dependency is defining biology  plasma cells that circulate rather than remain marrow-confined; enriched for adverse cytogenetic features including del(17p), t(11;14), gain/amplification(1q), del(13q), complex karyotype, and in some cases t(4;14); extramedullary disease common (liver, spleen, lymph nodes; also pleural effusions, soft tissue, skin, and CNS in some cases); may show more immature/plasmablastic features
